mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp over 3 months) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE trigger activates but SPX 5-day returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI inflation rate exceeds 3% and the Fed funds rate is below 1%, it signals a high-inflation/low-rate regime that will erode real yields and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month decline in housing starts signals a weakening consumer sector that will pressure corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 6-month HOUST decline persists but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment growth slows by > 100k jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a rapidly cooling labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS growth slows by > 100k for 2 months
failure_condition: PAYEMS trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM Manufacturing Index (proxied by INDPRO) and the unemployment rate both signal contractionary conditions (INDPRO < 50 and UNRATE > 6%), it predicts a broad economic slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO and UNRATE trigger activates but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the Fed funds rate exceeds 5% and the CPI inflation rate is above 4%, it signals a high-rate/high-inflation regime that will pressure financial conditions and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL trigger activates but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.
